_about: Crawler site register (ADR-097). DRAFT from web research on 4 Oct 2026: a site is crawled only when "approved": true (owner's review). verified = a listing page was fetched and showed document links. Many UP CMS sites timed out from the research host (likely geo/IP filtering); re-verify from the Mac in India. Platform notes: UP CMS sites use /en|hi/governmentorders?cd=<menu id>, /en|hi/archivegovernmentorders, PDFs under /site/writereaddata/UploadGovermentOrder/pdf/ or /downloadmedia/UploadGovermentOrder/pdf/ (pager 'Displaying 1 - 10 of 116123' = 116 items + page links). S3WaaS district sites: /documents/, /document-category/<slug>/, /notice_category/<slug>/ (mostly local notices; low priority). Some hosts redirect HTTPS to HTTP (do not force HTTPS); treasuries.up.nic.in needs legacy TLS; JS/postback lists need a headless browser (uppolice, upneda, doptcirculars, GeM). Avoid unofficial mirrors. Crawler v1 (ADR-103): optional fields docLinkPattern (regex for document links that do not end in .pdf), followPattern (index pages to follow one level), maxPages (default 20), fileHosts (other government hosts holding the files), coveredBy (adapter that already reads the site; crawler skips it). Plain http is used only for hosts written with http:// here. Hosts outside .gov.in/.nic.in (awasbandhu.in, upsrlm.org, upprd.in, uppcl.org, upneda.org.in, upsbcc.in) need adding to src/lib/government-hosts.ts and apps/web/lib/government-hosts.ts by the owner first.
